notes.title: Etheriia - Travelogue - Now Available in English
notes.content:
"[b]Hey, Travelers![/b]

We have exciting news for the Etheriia community: Etheriia - Travelogue is now available in English! Get ready to explore the sensual realms of sci-fi, medieval, and elven worlds with a more immersive experience. Uncover mysteries alongside Aerith, Luna, and the Warrior in your preferred language.

Languages Available:
[list] []English (Narration, subtitles, and interface) []Russian (Subtitles and interface) []Portuguese (Brazil) (Subtitles and interface) []Japanese (Subtitles and interface) []Korean (Subtitles and interface) []Simplified Chinese (Narration, subtitles, and interface) []Traditional Chinese (Subtitles and interface) []German (Subtitles and interface) [/list]

With the support of our fans, Etheriia - Travelogue strives to become an accessible and unforgettable experience. Help us continue expanding this universe by adding the game to your wishlist and inviting friends to join this interdimensional adventure!

[b]See you soon,[/b]
AxiaGameStudio"
